title: Anomaly induced transport in holographic superconductors
summary: We investigate the anomaly-induced transport properties of a holographic superconductor exhibiting spontaneous symmetry breaking. The holographic model incorporates vector and axial gauge fields, an additional non-anomalous $U(1)$ symmetry, and a charged scalar field that drives the phase transition. Working in the probe limit, we numerically construct the superconducting background under two alternative scalar field quantizations, corresponding to operators with scaling dimensions $Δ=1$ and $Δ=3$ (denoted as the $O_1$ and $O_2$ theories, respectively).
